contentText: As protests continue in Iran, the Norway-based NGO Iran Human Rights (IHR) says it's confirmed 648 people killed during the unrest. It said an estimated 10,000 people had also been arrested. Over two weeks of demonstrations initially sparked by economic grievances have turned into one of the biggest challenges yet to the theocratic government, and protesters keep to the streets despite the brutal crackdown.
